[Question] Juan and LaKeisha roll a few objects down a ramp. They want to see which object rolls the farthest. What should they do so they can repeat their investigation?
[Options] A) Put the objects in groups. B) Change the height of the ramp. C) Choose different objects to roll. D) Record the details of the investigation.
[Number of answers] 2
[Answer 1]
